lines.text: They said in their hearts,
“We will crush them completely.”
They burned down every place
where God met us in the land.
There are no signs for us to see.
There is no longer any prophet.
And none of us knows how long this will last.
How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You?
Will the foe revile Your name forever?
Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand?
Stretch it out to destroy them!
Yet God is my King from ancient times,
working salvation on the earth.
You divided the sea by Your strength;
You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
You crushed the heads of Leviathan;
You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
You broke open the fountain and the flood;
You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
The day is Yours, and also the night;
You established the moon and the sun.
You set all the boundaries of the earth;
You made the summer and winter.

pictures.scene: Alfred Wierusz-Kowalski, Wilki w nocy — the wolves coming on together over the snow in the dark, they said in their hearts, we will crush them completely
pictures.name: pd_wierusz_kowalski_wilki_w_nocy

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, Nocturnal Fire in a Dutch City — the whole town lit up by the fire burning through it at night, they burned down every place where God met us in the land
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_nocturnal_fire

pictures.scene: Philips Koninck, Rivierlandschap — the enormous flat country under an empty sky with nothing standing up in it, there are no signs for us to see, there is no longer any prophet
pictures.name: pd_koninck_rivierlandschap

pictures.scene: Isidor Kaufmann, The Kabbalist — the old scholar sitting still over his book waiting on an answer, and none of us knows how long this will last, how long O God will the enemy taunt You
pictures.name: pd_kaufmann_the_kabbalist

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, Kruisdraging — the jeering faces pressed in around Christ on the road, will the foe revile Your name forever, why do You withdraw Your strong right hand
pictures.name: pd_bosch_kruisdraging

pictures.scene: Markus Pernhart, Großglockner von der Hohenwartscharte — the great peak and its glacier standing up out of the cloud, stretch it out to destroy them, yet God is my King from ancient times
pictures.name: pd_pernhart_grossglockner

pictures.scene: Louis Meijer, Storm in het Nauw van Calais — the sea heaped up and split open under the ships in the gale, working salvation on the earth, You divided the sea by Your strength
pictures.name: pd_meijer_storm_nauw_van_calais

pictures.scene: Andrea Vaccaro, Tobias and the Fish — the great fish dragged up out of the river and held down on the bank, You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea, You crushed the heads of Leviathan
pictures.name: pd_vaccaro_tobias_and_the_fish

pictures.scene: Jan Asselijn, De doorbraak van de Sint-Anthonisdijk bij Amsterdam — the dike burst open and the water pouring through the gap across the land, You fed him to the creatures of the desert, You broke open the fountain and the flood
pictures.name: pd_asselijn_doorbraak_sint_anthonisdijk

pictures.scene: Eugen Bracht, Rast in der Syrischen Wüste — the dry bed and the burnt sand of the desert with the travellers halted on it, You dried up the ever-flowing rivers, the day is Yours and also the night
pictures.name: pd_bracht_rast_in_der_syrischen_wueste

pictures.scene: Herman van Swanevelt, Italiaans landschap — the two men under the great tree looking out over the plain to the far horizon, You established the moon and the sun, You set all the boundaries of the earth
pictures.name: pd_swanevelt_italiaans_landschap

pictures.scene: Charles Leickert, Stadsgezicht in de winter — the snow lying on the roofs of the town and the smoke going up from the chimneys, You made the summer and winter, remember how the enemy has mocked You O LORD
pictures.name: pd_leickert_stadsgezicht_in_de_winter
